gates.approval_before_orderHelp: When on, an order needs an approved request first.
gates.receipt_before_invoiceHelp: When on, a vendor invoice needs a goods receipt first.

notes.placeholder: Add a note for the approval or rejection…

sod.reviewerGuidance: You may approve or reject this request. The requester cannot self-approve — separation of duties requires a different reviewer.
sod.paymentApproverGuidance: Payment must be released by a different finance user — the approver can't also pay this request.
sod.paymentReleaseGuidance: Releasing payment — the approver can't also pay (separation of duties). You may mark this as paid below.

sod.receiptGate: To advance from Purchase Order to Goods Receipt, the requester or a Project-Manager must confirm receipt of the goods.
